one_line: There is no active solicitation to answer, and the contemplated prime contract is for a local nonprofit operator; Temporary 123 fits a possible sanitation subcontract.
scope: Thornton is considering a six-month Safe Parking pilot with 5–10 spaces, trash services, hand washing stations, porta potties, intake and background checks, and quarterly reporting and data sharing. The contracted model anticipates a local nonprofit providing services for an estimated $98,000. Staff does not recommend Safe Parking and instead recommends exploring an Aurora Regional Navigation Campus partnership.
fit: Portable sanitation, handwashing equipment, water support, waste removal, and servicing align with the company’s facility support capabilities and fleet (company profile; price list).
Nationwide coverage includes Colorado, and the Denver shelter restroom-trailer contract provides relevant sanitation experience (company profile, operations and past performance).

Company NAICS 624230 and 624221 are related coverage, but the listed opportunity code 624229 is not in the supplied company profile. Company PSCs are W023, W099, and W045; no opportunity PSC is stated (company profile; bid pack).
Active GSA MAS #47QSMS25D00AM includes SINs 532490P, 561210FS, 561210FAC, and 541614; the packet establishes no GSA purchasing route or required SIN (company profile; bid pack).
red_flags: This is an agenda/planning packet, not an RFP, sources sought notice, or RFI; it supplies no submission instructions.
Model 2 contemplates an RFP contract with a local nonprofit. The supplied company profile establishes SBE and MBE status but does not establish local nonprofit eligibility.
Intake, background checks, case management, housing navigation, and program reporting extend beyond the demonstrated equipment and sanitation scope.
Safe Parking requires zoning changes and suitable zoning districts; site selection, Council direction, and funding remain unresolved (attachment, Safe Parking slides 15–19).
No set-aside is stated. SBE/MBE status does not establish eligibility for the contemplated local nonprofit operator role.
Mandatory site visits, bonding, licenses, equipment quantities, and performance dates are not specified.
competition: No Safe Parking incumbent, past winner, or offer count is supplied; the bid pack reports zero agency awards and zero benchmarks under NAICS 624229. The Aurora partnership is the staff-recommended alternative, not an identified Safe Parking awardee.
price_signal: $98,000 is a planning estimate for the entire contracted six-month model, not an award or sanitation budget. The $26,000 city-staff model has different staffing responsibilities and is not a comparable contractor award. No comparable award prices are supplied; the company price list lacks confirmed billing basis and complete delivery and servicing terms, so it cannot support a six-month quote.
must_have: No current submission package or response is requested (source: attachment, Homelessness Sheltering Options communication and Safe Parking slides 17–20).
Prospective operator: local nonprofit under Model 2; this is a planning condition pending an actual RFP (source: attachment, Safe Parking slide 17).

Prospective services: trash, hand washing stations, porta potties, intake and background checks, quarterly reports and data sharing, with case management and housing navigation identified in the contracted model (source: attachment, Safe Parking slide 17).

Implementation depends on site feasibility, site agreement, contracts or partnerships, and completion of site requirements; zoning changes are also identified (source: attachment, Safe Parking slides 15 and 19).
